description: This file contains extension methods for configuring content part display drivers within the OrchardCore CMS framework, including registration, removal, and configuration of display modes and editors.

classes.name: ContentPartServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for registering and configuring content part display drivers in dependency injection.

methods.name: UseDisplayDriver
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a content part and all display modes/editors, overriding previous registrations.

methods.name: RemoveDisplayDriver
methods.description: Removes a display driver from all display modes and editors.

methods.name: ForDisplayMode
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a specific display mode, with overloads for all modes or specific modes with predicates.

methods.name: ForEditor
methods.description: Registers a display driver for all editors or a specific editor, with overloads for predicates.
